items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Joe Louis – all the champions, they’d come to the clubs and listen to you play.

ctx.x: Who was – do you have any recollections, any memories, from those early days in New York?

Of course. I can’t think of all the recollections at this point, but man, it was – first of all, let me say this. New York at that time was so beautiful. Harlem, oh, man. Sugar Ray Robinson’s bar. It was just very exciting. You could see anybody. Joe Louis – all the champions, they’d come to the clubs and listen to you play. It was an exciting period almost all over the world, but New York was the Mecca. The music.
